channel.title: Crypto Front Page
channel.description: Crypto Front Page reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto industry.

item.title: What Is Block Finality? Why Your Bridge Transfer Waits
item.description: Block finality is when a block can no longer be reversed. Bridges wait so a deposit cannot vanish after its funds are released on another chain.

item.title: How to restake an LST and delegate it on EigenLayer
item.description: First time restaking on EigenLayer: fund a wallet, deposit a supported LST, delegate it to an operator, and verify the balance on Ethereum.

item.title: USDC from Polygon to Ethereum: Aggregator Routes
item.description: How to move USDC from Polygon to Ethereum: keep POL for gas, choose the USDC you hold, then approve and confirm a route to Ethereum mainnet.

item.title: Shibarium’s Checkpointed Sidechain Design
item.description: Is Shibarium a layer 2 or a sidechain? It is a checkpointed sidechain: BONE-staked validators confirm transactions, while Ethereum records checkpoints.

item.title: DOJ gets authority over $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, part of $2.7 billion frozen overall.

item.title: How to Check a ShibaSwap Trade on Etherscan
item.description: To check an Ethereum swap transaction on Etherscan, search its wallet hash, read the status, then compare token transfers with the trade you intended.

item.title: US authorizes seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, part of a wider freeze still being traced.

item.title: Difference between RenBridge and RenVM: app versus network
item.description: RenBridge was the web app for requesting cross-chain transfers; RenVM was the Darknode network that held the underlying assets and signed the messages…

item.title: LI.FI Bridge Routing: Choosing the Right Cross-Chain Route
item.description: When should you use lifi bridge? Choose it for a fast rollup exit, a cross-chain swap or competing routes; use canonical or CEX routes for large or unsupported transfers.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2B in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: US authorities say providers have frozen $2.7 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion theft, with court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion.

item.title: US can seize or restrain $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says partners froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack funds, with court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorised seizure or restraint of $1.2 billion from the $2.7 billion frozen after Binance’s $6.3 billion theft, as tracing continues.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, while tracing and recovery efforts continue.

item.title: US authorizes seizure of $1.2bn in Binance theft funds
item.description: The Justice Department secured authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds, part of a wider freeze that now exceeds $2.7 billion.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2 billion in Binance hack crypto
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, while recovery efforts continue.

item.title: Injective’s Veyra upgrade enters vote before Nov. 24 target
item.description: Injective opened a governance vote on Veyra, a proposed v1.21.0 upgrade that would halt the chain at block 193,145,000 on Nov. 24 if approved.

item.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all users
item.description: Chainalysis says an attacker exposed names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users, prompting account resets and a staged shutdown of its tools.

item.title: Deutsche Bank custody service goes live for paying clients
item.description: Deutsche Bank's custody service is live for paying European clients, holding keys for selected crypto assets as it explores tokenized products.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a blockchain route for participating issuers and acquirers to settle obligations in stablecoins, with privacy tools planned for later.

item.title: Avalanche named ledger for NYSE-affiliated tokenized market
item.description: Ava Labs says Avalanche will provide the ledger for clearing trades on an NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities venue designed to trade and settle around the clock.
